impact:
tests-ts/snapshot-fakefs.mjs describes itself as "In-memory SnapshotFs with failure injection" in a comment, but carries no @type annotation and is never structurally checked against the SnapshotFs interface. node-fs.ts (the real implementation) is type-checked; the fake is not.

Consequence: adding a method to SnapshotFs, or changing a signature, breaks the real implementation loudly at compile time and the fake silently — it fails only if some test happens to exercise that method, and a fake that has diverged from the real seam is a suite that proves things about a filesystem nobody ships. A `/** @type {import("../src/snapshot/types.js").SnapshotFs} */` annotation (checkJs is already on for this suite) makes the drift a compile error.
title: [T-010] FakeFs is never type-checked against SnapshotFs, so the seam can drift silently
